reason: Driven and confirmed: after a valid date, render-b.js only rewrites #b-empty-hint. The heading still asks "When is the day?", the primary still reads "Set the day", and "Moments come next" points at nothing pressable. A success state that contradicts its own question and offers no next action is a dead end, not taste. The behaviour gate asserts only aria-invalid=false, so this is not gate-restated.
sharpenedFix: Do not add a twelfth state; owner-empty is already one of the eleven graded states and the answered form is an interaction inside it, not a new state. In render-b.js's setday success branch, re-render .b-empty in place: heading becomes the horizon (count from F.days(F.today, iso) plus the long-form date), the form is replaced by one primary "Add a moment", and an empty measure carries a single line saying nothing sits between today and the day yet. Move focus to the new primary and keep the role=status announcement. Recapture the existing owner-empty frames only if the unanswered form changes.
